limitations.open_interest: OKX public market-data API historical open-interest coverage is limited to the latest 30 days in this Stage 1 collector; not a 2-year series.
limitations.fear_greed: Daily series, not hourly. No synthetic interpolation is performed.
limitations.order_book: No historical order-book snapshots stored in Stage 1.
limitations.liquidations: No verified historical liquidation feed stored in Stage 1.
limitations.basis: No continuous historical basis series stored in Stage 1.
limitations.iran_access: A probe executed on GitHub-hosted infrastructure does not establish reachability from the user's own Iranian IP/network.
